notes.title: Big Action Mega Fight! fixes pushed - 24th August, 2016
notes.content:
Howdy!

We've pushed a few minor fixes to build today. 

Thank you to everyone who is still enjoying the game, these are for YOU!

 Most notably we've revised the achievements which were proving difficult to trigger - go forth and be a completionist!

1. Fixed BAMF not quitting correctly when pressing ALT+F4.
2. Fixed "Yo Dawg" achievement being impossible to unlock.
3. Lowered thresholds for higher tier attach achievements (e.g. you now need to use your special only 250 times instead of 2000 to get gold).
4. Fixed some incorrect French translations, and the "Quitter" label sticking out of its button.

Those of you interested in our next game should hop over to http://dblstallion.com/alpha and sign-up for our free alpha testing program.

See you later!

notes.title: Big Action Mega Fight! winds up for a PC debut, arriving on Steam January 12th, 2016
notes.content:
As sub-zero temperatures grip our Canadian streets, your friendly neighbourhood independent game developer Double Stallion Games prepares to bring our award-winning mobile brawler to PC and Mac via Steam. 

Originally available on iOS and Android, Big Action Mega Fight! features a man who knows no such bounds, Brick Strongarm, who cuts a mighty swath through the street gangs of Megatropolis!

An homage to classic 90's beat-'em-ups like Double Dragon and Streets of Rage, hilarious cartoon fighting action meets tight controls for a satisfying slugfest. 

BAMF! also features the most ridiculous unlockable power moves ever. Want to administer a Fistnado to the face? Check. Feel like delivering an Orbital Punch to the solar plexus? No problem. How about a forecast of Poultry Rain for a little 'sploding chicken action? It’s all covered.

Visit us at [url=http://www.dblstallion.com]dblstallion.com[/url].
Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/dblstallion]Twitter[/url].
Or like us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/DoubleStallion]Facebook[/url].


[h1]Double Stallion Games[/h1]

We are an independent game studio based in Montreal, Canada founded in 2013 with the support of the indie game incubator Execution Labs.

We specialise in bringing beautiful and stylised hand-drawn aesthetics to innovative and polished game experiences.

We launched our first game, Big Action Mega Fight!, on IOS & Android in 2013 to wide acclaim and are bringing the game to PC, Mac and Linux in early 2016.

Recently we partnered with Cartoon Network to develop a game that will launch a new flagship cartoon series property. The game is a unique action-adventure experience where the player visits an original animated world full of surprises, perils and comedy and will launch early 2016.

We secured partnership and financial support from the Canada Media Fund (CMF) in 2014 to advance our next original project, a brawler and the spiritual successor to Big Action Mega Fight! the game is in the early stages of development.

[h1]Well, that's enough about us[/h1]

With that out of the way, all that's left to say is how excited we all are to finally bring Big Action Mega Fight! to your soon-to-be-broken control pads.
